d:
Long, shimmering azure blue hair that flows like liquid with a soft, wavy texture. Luminous pale turquoise, wide-set eyes with a distant expression. Appears to be an ageless, mature entity. Voluptuous and statuesque build. A translucent, iridescent gown in shades of seafoam green and pearl. A crown of polished coral and small pearls encircling the head.
BODY COLOR: pale iridescent
